name: Pinterest
scope: Pinterest for teens, as described in Pinterest's teen safety help article.

teen_private.summary: Pinterest says profiles of users under 18 are private.

evidence.quote: If you’re under 18, your profile will be private.

teen_contact.summary: Pinterest says users under 16 can exchange messages only with mutual followers.

evidence.quote: If you're under 16, you can exchange messages with mutual followers.
You can only be added to a group chat by people you follow and who follow you back.

teen_time.summary: Pinterest describes an experiment with school-day reminders. It does not describe a default time limit or break reminder for teens.

evidence.quote: We’re running an experiment and if you open the Pinterest app during the school day, you may see a reminder to put down your phone, pause notifications, and focus on school.

teen_night.summary: The documents we read describe no night-time quiet hours or bedtime reminders for teens.

teen_content.summary: The documents we read describe no default limit on sensitive content for teens.

parental.summary: Pinterest says teens can work with a parent or guardian to set a passcode that locks certain settings.

evidence.quote: Work with your parent or guardian to set up a passcode to lock certain settings related to account management, privacy and data, and social permissions.

feed_choice.summary: The documents we read describe no feed without personalized recommendations.

ranking.summary: Pinterest says it uses information about your activity on and off Pinterest to personalize your experience.

evidence.quote: We use information about your activity on and off Pinterest to help personalize your experience on the platform.

other.summary: Pinterest says comments are turned off on Pins created by users under 18, and that users under 18 in the EU or UK are opted out of ads personalization.

evidence.quote: If you’re under 18, comments will be automatically turned off on Pins you create until you turn 18.
If you're under 18 in the EU or UK, note that you’re automatically opted out of all ads personalization settings.
